dataset-of-origin.detail: Autistic participants drawn from 6 of the 7 datasets: ABIDE (I+II), POND Network, HBN (CMI; 3 sites), Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD (femaleASD), UK MRC-AIMS (Cambridge site only), and UCSD Biomarkers of Autism. ADHD-200 contributed ADHD and TD participants only, not autism. POND, UK MRC-AIMS, and UCSD are not listed in the normalized keyword list and are omitted from the answer array.

disorder-name.detail: Co-occurring autism and ADHD (autism+ADHD) subgroup (N=203). Participants with documented clinical diagnoses of both autism (primary) and ADHD (secondary). Treated as a separate exploratory analytical group in this study. These 203 individuals are a subset of the main ASD clinical cohort (N=1399). Note: no dedicated Minor Category exists for ASD+ADHD co-occurrence; classified as ASD (primary diagnosis).
disorder-name.supporting_text: "We conducted an exploratory analysis to examine whether individuals with co-occurring autism and ADHD had unique neuroanatomical profiles. We compared a subgroup of 203 individuals with recorded clinical diagnoses of both conditions (autism + ADHD)"
disorder-name.location: Bedford2025.pdf.md: Methods / Statistical Analysis / Co-occurring Autism and ADHD, L77

dataset-of-origin.detail: Autism+ADHD subgroup (N=203) drawn from CMI HBN (3 sites: CBIC N=32, RU N=40, SI N=20), POND SickKids (N=32), and ABIDE sites (EMC N=7, IP N=6, KKI N=4, NYU N=43, OHSU N=14, ONRC N=1, SBL N=1, UCD N=3). ABIDE sites all belong to ABIDE I or ABIDE II. POND not in normalized keyword list and omitted from answer array.
